metric_definitions.success_rate_pct: 3 blocks within target XY radius 0.06m and all pairwise Z gaps >0.03m; instantaneous
metric_definitions.hand_jerk_m_s3: per-rollout RMS norm of third finite differences of actual TCP XYZ, then mean
metric_definitions.boundary_jump_rad_s: per-rollout RMS norm of joint delta changes / dt at replan boundaries, then mean
metric_definitions.plan_ms: mean synchronized wall-clock plan latency per rollout, then mean; filter time is excluded
metric_definitions.command_jerk_rad_s3: mean norm of second differences of seven joint action deltas / dt^3

limitations: 7 assigned contexts and 21 rollouts per combo per condition; not the full 30-context result
One training seed and zero-delay ID/OOD simulation only
ID used RTX 3090; OOD used RTX 3090, RTX A5000 and RTX A6000; cross-condition comparisons include hardware differences
Timing includes concurrent GPU processes; do not compare ID/OOD timing as isolated algorithm latency
Success and smoothness are distinct; observed rankings are exploratory
